endorsements.name: Rohitesh Gupta
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-1003
endorsements.description: One of the API in Mattermost version 6.3.0 and earlier fails to properly protect the permissions, which allows the system administrators to combine the two distinct privileges/capabilities in a way that allows them to override certain restricted configurations like EnableUploads.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: LOW (CVSS 3.1, 3.3)
